candidates.requirement: After creating or initializing the same ZSTD_DStream and before decoding a magicless frame, select ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless with ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat so ZSTD_decompressStream can exercise the new supported format.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates and initializes dstream, makes input/output buffers from fuzz bytes, and calls ZSTD_decompressStream on that same object.
candidates.failure_condition: The entry leaves format at ZSTD_f_zstd1. A valid magicless frame lacks the standard four-byte magic, so the default parser returns an error and the target exits the decoding loop without executing the magicless branch.
candidates.alternative_paths: Input bytes cannot alter dstream->format. The complete entry has no format setter; its init and reset calls do not select magicless format. The generic decoder delegates to the same stream operation, and the separate magicless test is not this entry.

before.requirement: Decode magicless frames by selecting the magicless format on the stream.
before.reason: The before decoder required the standard frame magic and had no format field or ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat implementation for this route.

source_evidence.quote: Verified preimage file lib/decompress/zstd_decompress.c has no function definition named ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat. The entire after definition consists of added lines. This establishes absence in this file only; other implementations or equivalent paths must still be considered.

after.requirement: Select ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless on the same DStream before streaming decompression of a magicless frame.
after.reason: The new contract requires explicit format selection. Creation defaults to standard format, and the harness only initializes, resets, and decodes; its bytes cannot select the format.

source_evidence.quote:
/*! ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat() :
 *  Instruct the decoder context about what kind of data to decode next.
 *  This instruction is mandatory to decode data without a fully-formed header,
 *  such ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless for example.
 * @return : 0, or an error code (which can be tested using ZSTD_isError()).
 */
ZSTDLIB_API size_t ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat(ZSTD_DCtx* dctx, ZSTD_format_e format);

claims.reason: The same old harness is assessed on both sides. Its missing format setter blocks a newly supported route after the change; before the change, that route was not supported.
